definitions.explanation: The state of being completely cut off or separated from others, whether physically, socially, or emotionally. Implies a greater degree of separation than ordinary isolation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{隔絶|かくぜつ}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To be completely isolated from the outside world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文明|ぶんめい}→文明：03611_bunmei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{隔絶|かくぜつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: To live in a village cut off from civilization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隔絶|かくぜつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More people are feeling a sense of severance from society.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{隔絶|かくぜつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{山間|さんかん}→山間：12589_sankan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集落|しゅうらく}→集落：19622_shuuraku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{救援物資|きゅうえんぶっし}→救援物資：17113_kyuuenbusshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: Relief supplies reached the mountain settlement that had been cut off by snow.

notes:
Describes a thorough, complete separation — stronger than ⟦{隔離|かくり}→隔離：14532_kakuri⟧ (quarantine/isolation) or ⟦{孤立|こりつ}→孤立：12229_koritsu⟧ (solitude/standing alone). Often used for geographic remoteness or profound social disconnection. Can function as a noun or as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({隔絶|かくぜつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隔絶|かくぜつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: an isolated place
- {隔絶|かくぜつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧: an isolated environment
- ⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{隔絶|かくぜつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be cut off from the world
- {隔絶|かくぜつ}⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧: sense of isolation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{孤立|こりつ}→孤立：12229_koritsu⟧: isolation — emphasizes being alone, standing apart; more common in everyday usage
- ⟦{隔離|かくり}→隔離：14532_kakuri⟧: isolation, quarantine — often medical or enforced separation
- ⟦{断絶|だんぜつ}→断絶：12988_danzetsu⟧: severance, discontinuation — emphasizes a complete break in a relationship or connection
- ⟦{遮断|しゃだん}→遮断：15673_shadan⟧: cutoff, blockade — focuses on blocking communication or access

FORMS:
{隔|かく} (to separate, to partition) + {絶|ぜつ} (to sever, to cut off) — both characters reinforce the idea of complete separation.
